title: Yellow-gold pillowy Canadian chestnuts tagine
description: A date-night dish featuring the earthy sweetness of chestnuts, slow-cooked in a tagine with aromatic spices and wrapped in ti-leaf for a delicate presentation.

ingredients.name: chestnuts (1 pound)
ingredients.notes: fresh or canned, peeled and sliced

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in the tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the sliced chestnuts, cinnamon stick, and star anise. Stir to combine.
Cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the chestnuts are tender.
Transfer the tagine to a heatproof surface and let cool slightly.
To serve, place a portion of the chestnut mixture onto a ti-leaf leaf and fold the leaf to create a package.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional ti-leaf leaves if desired.
